findings.problem: Web bypasses the public core interface via direct and alias storage imports.

findings.consequence: Storage changes can force UI edits; native boundary check exits 1.
findings.fix: Export the needed service-price operation through the existing core index; change web callers to that public entry. Keep the existing permitted quote module as the representative example, documenting it in DESIGN.md.
findings.verification: Native rule-proof: public import valid; direct private import and alias import each fail with their diagnostic. Preserve the existing HTTP journey and unit public interface checks.

findings.principle: Approved checkout total remains 10; expectations must come from the design.
findings.consequence: Important checkout journey is broken despite passing unit tests.
findings.fix: Keep total-10 acceptance unchanged. Resolve owner pricing policy before choosing implementation; preserve the HTTP request and review whether the quote expectation 12 remains intended.

findings.problem: Unexported core a and b form an unconditional recursion and import cycle.
findings.consequence: Calling either helper never reaches a base case; maintained enforcement cannot pass cleanly.
findings.fix: Recommend deleting only the unused, unexported a.ts/b.ts pair after explicit selection. Alternative: accepted narrow debt with a reason and removal condition; do not invent helper behavior.
findings.verification: Core entry point and all callers reviewed; public checks preserved; native cycle positive/negative fixture proof. Deletion is subject to exact diff approval.

findings.problem: npm run check omits boundary, unit and checkout checks; current boundary traversal has unreported syntax limits.

findings.fix: Extend the existing check script with fail-fast TypeScript, native boundaries, unit and journey commands. Retain native compiler-based boundary analysis. Document static import/re-export scope and dynamic dependency review limitations rather than claiming exhaustive coverage.
findings.verification: Independent native boundary valid/violation proof for private, alias and cycle cases; equivalent re-export syntax within supported scope; maintained aggregate passes valid public and sibling-package control, fails seeded violation with the intended diagnostic.
